$comment: Generated by tool/protocol/generate.mjs from firmware/src/comms/dtc.h — do not edit.
source: firmware/src/comms/dtc.h (ids = enum order), set_in = the firmware sources that reference the DTC
code_rule: UDS DTC code = 0xD10000 | id (manufacturer range; the OEM mapping comes at integration). id 0 = DTC_NONE.

classes.no_arm: arming refused for the key cycle
classes.fault: a section 6 row / the FAULT state
classes.info: a record, no change of behaviour

dtcs.name: DTC_FS26_PROGID
dtcs.description: The FS26 OTP variant is not bound (cal_fs26_prog_id = 0xFFFF) or its M_PROGID is not the procured one.
dtcs.response: INIT fails: FS0B/FS1B are never released, no arming for the key cycle.
dtcs.header_comment: FW-12 OTP variant unbound / wrong

dtcs.name: DTC_FS26_OTP_CORRUPT
dtcs.description: The FS26 reports OTP_CORRUPT.
dtcs.response: No arming for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_FS26_DEBUG_MODE
dtcs.description: The FS26 is in debug mode (DBG_MODE).
dtcs.response: No arming for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_FS26_INIT_READBACK
dtcs.description: An INIT_FS register (WD_CFG, FSSM, WDW_DURATION with their NOT complements, SAFE_IOS_2) does not read back.
dtcs.response: No arming for the key cycle.
dtcs.header_comment: INIT registers or NOT pairs

dtcs.name: DTC_FS26_SPI
dtcs.description: SPI communication with the FS26 failed (frame CRC or no answer).
dtcs.response: No arming for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_FS26_WD
dtcs.description: A Q&A watchdog answer failed in the 1 ms task.
dtcs.response: Recorded; the FS26 itself counts the error (WD_ERR_LIMIT = 2) and asserts FS0B (hardware SPO) on a second failure.

dtcs.name: DTC_FS26_RELEASE
dtcs.description: FS0B/FS1B could not be released (FLT_ERR_CNT not back to 0).
dtcs.response: No arming; SENSOR_SELFTEST goes to FAULT after cal_sensor_selftest_ms + cal_fs0b_release_ms.

dtcs.name: DTC_FS1B_SHORT_HIGH
dtcs.description: FS1B is shorted high (the vehicle FAULT_OUT wire shorted to KL30).
dtcs.response: No arming until repaired; no MCU reset (BACKUP_SAFETY_PATH_FS1B = 0).
dtcs.header_comment: FAULT_OUT short to KL30: no arming until repaired

dtcs.name: DTC_FS26_GPIO1_OTP
dtcs.description: Gate power (RDY) came up before section 9 step 6 after a power-on: FS_GPIO1 is slotted in the FS26 OTP.
dtcs.response: SENSOR_SELFTEST goes to FAULT; no arming.
dtcs.header_comment: gate power up before §9 step 6: GPIO1 slotted

dtcs.name: DTC_HWID_OPEN
dtcs.description: HW_ID reads above 4.6 V (open).
dtcs.response: MCU_GATE_EN refused for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_HWID_SHORT
dtcs.description: HW_ID reads below 0.2 V (short).
dtcs.response: MCU_GATE_EN refused for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_HWID_UNKNOWN
dtcs.description: HW_ID is in no SKU window, or unstable, or (round 24) its eight boot reads were not eight new conversions (never converted, or a stopped converter repeating one).
dtcs.response: MCU_GATE_EN refused for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_SKU_MISMATCH
dtcs.description: The HW_ID SKU, the parameter-set SKU and the calibration SKU disagree.
dtcs.response: MCU_GATE_EN refused (an 8XX OV trip on a 4XX bank would destroy it).
dtcs.header_comment: FW-02

dtcs.name: DTC_CALIB_INVALID
dtcs.description: The FW-20 calibration record is missing or fails its version, CRC, range, SKU, serial, motor-ID or f_sw check (hello.calib.err bits).
dtcs.response: No torque, no arming; n_x unknown (every decision takes the n >= n_x column).
dtcs.header_comment: FW-20

dtcs.name: DTC_PARAMS_INVALID
dtcs.description: ti_params_validate() found violations (a cal_* out of range or a cross-field rule).
dtcs.response: No arming for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_PWM_LOCK
dtcs.description: The eFlexPWM fault lock-down does not match its image, or the REG_PROT lock does not read back (also when lost while running).
dtcs.response: No arming; while armed: the 'control lost' row.

dtcs.name: DTC_DESAT_HS
dtcs.description: A high-side driver tripped DESAT (FLT_HS); raised again at a power-up while its NVM record (this or the previous key cycle) blocks automatic arming.
dtcs.response: Hardware SPO at once (PWM fault input, fault latch -> DRV_EN); FW-15 sequence; below n_x SPO, at or above n_x PWM-ASC after the >= 1.5 ms driver reset; keep_hv per FW-08b; FAULT. One VCU-authorised retry per key cycle, >= 1 s later, below n_x, at reduced torque. Round 23: at the next power-up the record's block is FAULT until that authorisation, and this DTC names it (the DTC store is RAM).

dtcs.name: DTC_DESAT_LS
dtcs.description: A low-side driver tripped DESAT (FLT_LS); raised again at a power-up while its NVM record (this or the previous key cycle) blocks automatic arming.
dtcs.response: SPO at every speed (LS-ASC could short the link through a failed high side); FW-15; FAULT. Round 23: at the next power-up the record's block is FAULT until the VCU's retry authorisation, and this DTC names it.

dtcs.name: DTC_DESAT_REPEAT
dtcs.description: A second DESAT in the key cycle.
dtcs.response: Latched: no further retry this key cycle.
dtcs.header_comment: second DESAT: latched

dtcs.name: DTC_DESAT_PENDING_BOOT
dtcs.description: A driver FLT reads low at boot with V5GD healthy (a DESAT pending from before the reset).
dtcs.response: The state machine goes to FAULT, SPO with ASC masked, no arming.
dtcs.header_comment: FLT low at boot

dtcs.name: DTC_FLT_RECOVERY_FAIL
dtcs.description: The FW-15 recovery (>= 1.5 ms low, one-shot clear) did not release FLT, or RDY / ASC_CMD_RB read back wrong.
dtcs.response: The bridge stays in SPO; FAULT.

dtcs.name: DTC_OVERCURRENT
dtcs.description: A phase current crossed +/-1.25 x sqrt(2) x I_pk,rms (601 A 8XX / 707 A 4XX) in the hardware ADC compare (software backstop in the ISR) — outside cal_asc_oc_window_ms of an LS-ASC entry (round 23: inside it, DTC_ASC_OC_TRANSIENT).
dtcs.response: High sides forced off in hardware; the latched 'control lost' row: SPO below n_x, LS-ASC at or above n_x or at unknown speed; cleared only by a VCU fault reset below n_x.

dtcs.name: DTC_OVERVOLTAGE
dtcs.description: A V_DC channel crossed the OV trip (880 V 8XX / 530 V 4XX) in the hardware compare.
dtcs.response: High sides off, zero torque, ASC request <= 15.6 us after the crossing and PWM-ASC where section 6 permits; latched.

dtcs.name: DTC_ISNS_OPEN
dtcs.description: A phase-current channel is outside 0.2-4.8 V (open signal wire or unpowered sensor).
dtcs.response: Current sensing invalid: the 'control lost' row (SPO below n_x, LS-ASC above).

dtcs.name: DTC_ISNS_RANGE
dtcs.description: Phase-current sensing invalid (range) while none of the more specific causes applies.
dtcs.response: The 'control lost' row.

dtcs.name: DTC_ISNS_SUM
dtcs.description: |ia + ib + ic| above cal_isum_tol_a for cal_isum_debounce samples (latched).
dtcs.response: The 'control lost' row.

dtcs.name: DTC_ISNS_OFFSET
dtcs.description: The standstill zero-current offset differs from the EOL calibration by more than cal_isns_offset_tol_v (set at the check since round 23).
dtcs.response: The sensor self-test does not pass (section 9 step 3) and times out to FAULT (DTC_SENSOR_SELFTEST).

dtcs.name: DTC_ISNS_STALE
dtcs.description: Phase-current samples are stale or lost (no complete triplet, or the current loop stopped: FW-31).
dtcs.response: The 'control lost' row.

dtcs.name: DTC_VDC_DISAGREE
dtcs.description: |VDC1 - VDC2| above max(5 %, cal_vdc_disagree_floor_v).
dtcs.response: V_DC invalid (HV state UNKNOWN): SPO under rule (a) or (b), otherwise LS-ASC.

dtcs.name: DTC_VOFS
dtcs.description: The receivers' shared +0.5 V offset (VOFS) is outside 0.475-0.525 V: both channels invalid.
dtcs.response: The 'V_DC invalid' row.

dtcs.name: DTC_V5GD
dtcs.description: The gate-logic supply V5GD is outside 4.75-5.25 V.
dtcs.response: The V5GD row: SPO, ASC_CLR, V_DC invalid, no arming.

dtcs.name: DTC_VDC_FAILSAFE
dtcs.description: A V_DC channel reads below 0.25 V (the AMC1311 fail-safe state, not a dead bus).
dtcs.response: The 'V_DC invalid' row.

dtcs.name: DTC_VDC_STALE
dtcs.description: A V_DC channel sample is older than cal_vdc_stale_us - and (F244) it stays stale until a new conversion: a stopped converter's stamp does not read as fresh again near 2^32 us of its age.
dtcs.response: The 'V_DC invalid' row.

dtcs.name: DTC_VDC_BMS
dtcs.description: With the contactors reported closed, |V_DC - V_pack| > 3 % for cal_vdc_bms_debounce_ms.
dtcs.response: The battery-path row: zero current below n_x, LS-ASC above.

dtcs.name: DTC_RSLV_AMPLITUDE
dtcs.description: Resolver sin^2 + cos^2 outside [cal_rslv_amp_min, cal_rslv_amp_max] of its calibrated value for cal_rslv_debounce frames in a row (round 23: a single frame outside is kept out of the angle observer, nothing more).
dtcs.response: Resolver invalid: no angle-dependent torque; section 6 decides on the speed bound |n_last| + cal_speed_accel_max_rpm_s x t (round 23): SPO while it stays below n_x, LS-ASC once it reaches n_x, the n >= n_x column once it passes n_max.

dtcs.name: DTC_RSLV_EXCITATION
dtcs.description: The excitation monitor level is outside its window (the FW-30 planes).
dtcs.response: Resolver invalid (as DTC_RSLV_AMPLITUDE).

dtcs.name: DTC_RSLV_TRACKING
dtcs.description: The angle observer's tracking error exceeds cal_rslv_track_err_rad for cal_rslv_debounce updates.
dtcs.response: Resolver invalid.

dtcs.name: DTC_RSLV_ACCEL
dtcs.description: The angle observer's innovation implies an acceleration beyond cal_rslv_accel_max_rad_s2 (driveline bound) for cal_rslv_debounce frames in a row (round 23: a single such frame is kept out of the observer).
dtcs.response: Resolver invalid.

dtcs.name: DTC_RSLV_RATE
dtcs.description: The resolver speed disagrees with the back-EMF (voltage-model) speed while modulating.
dtcs.response: Resolver invalid.

dtcs.name: DTC_TEMP_MODULE
dtcs.description: A module NTC reading is invalid: open, short, or (round 23) its mean over cal_temp_rate_win_ms moving more than cal_temp_rate_db_codes ADC codes at more than cal_temp_rate_c_s — three such windows latch the channel for the key cycle.
dtcs.response: Derating falls to the continuous rating only while no module NTC is valid; no section-6 row. Passed when all three are valid again (round 23).

dtcs.name: DTC_TEMP_BOARD
dtcs.description: A board NTC reading is invalid (round 23: set while either is, passed when both are valid).
dtcs.response: Recorded; the board NTCs take no part in the derating.

dtcs.name: DTC_TEMP_MOTOR
dtcs.description: A motor temperature sensor reading is invalid (round 23: set while either is, passed when both are valid).
dtcs.response: Recorded; the statistics (FW-43) and the fault records use the valid one.

dtcs.name: DTC_OVERTEMP
dtcs.description: The hottest valid module NTC at the end of its derating band, cal_tmod_derate_end_c (round 23; passed below that end less cal_derate_hyst_c).
dtcs.response: Information beside the response, which is the FW-04 derating (no torque left at the band's end); no section-6 row.

dtcs.name: DTC_HVIL_OPEN
dtcs.description: The HVIL signature reads open while armed.
dtcs.response: The command-lost row: torque ramped to zero within 100 ms, then SPO below n_x / current control kept above; HVIL open is not a licence to open the contactors at speed.

dtcs.name: DTC_HVIL_SHORT
dtcs.description: The HVIL loop is shorted to ground or to the supply while armed.
dtcs.response: The command-lost row (as DTC_HVIL_OPEN).

dtcs.name: DTC_CAN_TIMEOUT
dtcs.description: VCU_CMD stale (> 20 ms, or a frozen alive counter) while armed.
dtcs.response: The command-lost row and the battery-path row (the contactor state is unknown): zero current below n_x, LS-ASC above; never 'hold the last value'.

dtcs.name: DTC_BMS_TIMEOUT
dtcs.description: VCU_BMS stale (> cal_bms_timeout_ms) while armed.
dtcs.response: Zero regen; motoring keeps the FW-03 envelope.

dtcs.name: DTC_CAN_E2E
dtcs.description: A vehicle frame failed its E2E CRC.
dtcs.response: The frame is discarded (its staleness then counts).

dtcs.name: DTC_QDIS_STUCK_OFF
dtcs.description: Active discharge commanded but the link did not decay within 200 ms.
dtcs.response: HV state from the witnesses; the passive bleeder bounds the time to < 60 V.

dtcs.name: DTC_QDIS_STUCK_ON
dtcs.description: The link decays at the active-discharge rate with QDIS off (a shorted switch).
dtcs.response: Latched service lock kept in NVM across key cycles: no arming, 'service required' and 'open the contactors' on CAN; cleared only by the UDS routine 0xF010 (FW-32) at the next power-up.

dtcs.name: DTC_QDIS_RATE_LIMIT
dtcs.description: A discharge request beyond 3 per 5 min.
dtcs.response: Refused (thermal recovery of the resistors).

dtcs.name: DTC_TAU_MISMATCH
dtcs.description: The key-off discharge time constant is more than 20 % off the SKU's expected tau.
dtcs.response: Recorded (plausibility only, not the SKU proof).
dtcs.header_comment: FW-02 key-off plausibility

dtcs.name: DTC_PRECHARGE_PLATEAU
dtcs.description: The precharge settled below 97.5 % of the pack (a shorted QDIS or resistor string).
dtcs.response: Arming refused for the key cycle.
dtcs.header_comment: FW-19

dtcs.name: DTC_PRECHARGE_TAU
dtcs.description: The precharge 63 % time is shorter than cal_precharge_tau_min_s.
dtcs.response: Arming refused for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_PRECHARGE_TIMEOUT
dtcs.description: No precharge verdict within cal_precharge_timeout_ms.
dtcs.response: Arming refused for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_SELFTEST_FAIL
dtcs.description: An FW-16 gate self-test step did not read back as expected.
dtcs.response: No arming; the failed step is kept in NVM.
dtcs.header_comment: FW-16 step mismatch

dtcs.name: DTC_SELFTEST_NO_PASS
dtcs.description: FW-16 was skipped (its measured conditions did not hold) and no pass is stored from this or the previous key cycle.
dtcs.response: No arming.
dtcs.header_comment: skipped with no stored pass

dtcs.name: DTC_GATE_POWER
dtcs.description: RDY_HS / RDY_LS not up within cal_rdy_timeout_ms, or lost.
dtcs.response: No PWM; FAULT.
dtcs.header_comment: FW-14

dtcs.name: DTC_SPO_ENERGY
dtcs.description: Section 6 holds an SPO while neither rule (a) nor rule (b) holds.
dtcs.response: 'No safe state proven' on CAN (INV_STATUS b14.0).
dtcs.header_comment: §6 SPO forced while neither rule (a) nor (b) holds

dtcs.name: DTC_CTRL_NONFINITE
dtcs.description: A NaN/Inf was caught before the PWM (FOC or torque path).
dtcs.response: PWM off; the 'control lost' row.
dtcs.header_comment: NaN/Inf caught before the PWM

dtcs.name: DTC_NVM
dtcs.description: An NVM record could not be written or read.
dtcs.response: Recorded; the write is retried by the queue.

dtcs.name: DTC_SENSOR_SELFTEST
dtcs.description: The section 9 step 3 sensor self-test did not pass within cal_sensor_selftest_ms (round 23: set at the timeout).
dtcs.response: FAULT, no arming for the key cycle.

dtcs.name: DTC_GAINS
dtcs.description: No current-loop gain set within the section 2 crossover ceiling for the calibrated f_sw and motor.
dtcs.response: No arming.
dtcs.header_comment: no gain set within the §2 ceiling

dtcs.name: DTC_ARM_EVIDENCE
dtcs.description: The FLT -> PWM fault route is not bound, or there is no valid EOL/HIL validation record for this image, SKU and card.
dtcs.response: No arming, fail closed; INV_STATUS b15 names the missing items.
dtcs.header_comment: round 14: IMCR route unbound or no valid EOL/HIL validation record

dtcs.name: DTC_TORQUE_INFEASIBLE
dtcs.description: No voltage-feasible current exists even at iq = 0 at this speed and V_DC.
dtcs.response: Zero torque, a speed-limit request (INV_STATUS b14.3).
dtcs.header_comment: F23: no voltage-feasible current even at iq = 0: zero torque + speed limit

dtcs.name: DTC_ISNS_STUCK
dtcs.description: A phase shows no current where its reference asks for it (a channel stuck at its zero level).
dtcs.response: The 'control lost' row.
dtcs.header_comment: F24: a phase shows no current where its reference asks for it

dtcs.name: DTC_RSLV_STALE
dtcs.description: No coherent resolver frame within cal_rslv_hold_us.
dtcs.response: The angle is withdrawn: the 'resolver invalid' row.
dtcs.header_comment: round 16 (A14-R01/R02): no coherent resolver frame within cal_rslv_hold_us

dtcs.name: DTC_RSLV_SWG_SAT
dtcs.description: The SWG trim is at its top code and the excitation monitor is still below the setpoint.
dtcs.response: The resolver never becomes ready: no arming.
dtcs.header_comment: round 16 (A14-N01): SWG trim at its top code, monitor still below the setpoint

dtcs.name: DTC_SERVICE_LOCK_CLEARED
dtcs.description: The UDS routine 0xF010 cleared the stuck-on QDIS service lock.
dtcs.response: A record; the clear takes effect at the next power-up.
dtcs.header_comment: round 17 (FW-32): the UDS routine cleared the stuck-on QDIS lock (a record, not a failure)

dtcs.name: DTC_LV_OVERVOLTAGE
dtcs.description: VSUP (KL30 at the FS26) above 20 V.
dtcs.response: Information: RUN and the torque unchanged; its first/last stamps give the duration.
dtcs.header_comment: round 17: VSUP above VSUP_OV — information; its first/last stamps give the duration

dtcs.name: DTC_LV_OV_SUSTAINED
dtcs.description: The LV overvoltage lasted longer than its band (500 ms above 27 V, 65 s at or below).
dtcs.response: The command-lost ramp until VSUP is back below 19.5 V.
dtcs.header_comment: round 17: VSUPOV longer than its band allows: the orderly ramp to zero torque

dtcs.name: DTC_LV_VSUP_UNKNOWN
dtcs.description: No VSUP reading (below 4.2 V on the FS26 AMUX).
dtcs.response: LV supervision off (information).
dtcs.header_comment: round 17: no VSUP reading from the FS26 AMUX: LV supervision off (information)

dtcs.name: DTC_RSLV_REACQUIRED
dtcs.description: The resolver frame ring re-acquired after an ambiguous completion, or a synchronized producer restart ran.
dtcs.response: Information; the FW-28 age-out selects any safe state; restarts are bounded by cal_rslv_restart_max per key cycle.
dtcs.header_comment: round 18 (A16-R02): the resolver frame ring re-acquired after an ambiguous completion — information (the FW-28 age-out selects any safe state); one occurrence per event. Round 19 (A17-R01): also each synchronized producer restart after a phase loss

dtcs.name: DTC_TORQUE_POSTCOND
dtcs.description: Torque -> current refused its own result (a postcondition failure: a software fault).
dtcs.response: No current reference; the 'control lost' row while armed.
dtcs.header_comment: round 23 (FW-37): torque -> current refused its own result: no current reference, the §6 "control lost" row while armed

dtcs.name: DTC_OVERSPEED
dtcs.description: The measured speed (a valid resolver's) in the overspeed warning band (cal_ovs_warn_frac x n_max) or trip band (cal_ovs_trip_frac x n_max), debounced cal_ovs_debounce_ms, with hysteresis; one occurrence per event, passed after it.
dtcs.response: Warning: the command-lost row (torque ramped to zero), the speed-limit request, no arming. Trip: also the latched 'control lost' row — SPO below n_x under the energy rule, LS-ASC at or above it (section 6 decides; no ASC of its own).
dtcs.header_comment: round 23 (FW-42): the measured speed in the overspeed warning or trip band (n_max_rpm of the calibration record); one occurrence per event, stamped over it

dtcs.name: DTC_FW_UPDATE
dtcs.description: The UDS programming session (0x10 02) was entered: a record of the session, not a failure.
dtcs.response: The FW-24 validated evidence is withdrawn and arming forbidden until the next power-up (FAULT; INV_STATUS b15 names the missing evidence); the section 6 actions keep their authority.
dtcs.header_comment: round 23 (FW-38): the UDS programming session was entered — no arming until the next power-up (a record of the session, not a failure)

dtcs.name: DTC_FW_FALLBACK
dtcs.description: The bootloader refused or abandoned the last activation, or restored the last known good image (the boot record's `last`).
dtcs.response: A record at the power-up; the image that runs is the one the bootloader accepted.
dtcs.header_comment: round 23 (FW-38): the bootloader refused or abandoned the last activation, or restored the last known good image (boot record `last`)

dtcs.name: DTC_MC_ABORTED
dtcs.description: A commissioning routine (RoutineControl 0xF020) aborted; its reason is in the routine's results (index 0).
dtcs.response: The normal safe state: no service modulation, the bridge armed idle, or the section 6 decision when a fault row caused it. A record: the cause, if a failure, has its own DTC.
dtcs.header_comment: round 23 (FW-39): a commissioning routine aborted — its reason in the routine's results (a record: the cause, if a failure, has its own DTC)

dtcs.name: DTC_MC_CAL_WRITTEN
dtcs.description: The commissioning sealed a new FW-20 calibration record version (RoutineControl 0xF021).
dtcs.response: A record: the running key cycle keeps its record; the next key cycle's init validates the new one.
dtcs.header_comment: round 23 (FW-39): the commissioning wrote a new FW-20 record version — it takes effect at the next key cycle (a record, not a failure)

dtcs.name: DTC_ASC_OC_TRANSIENT
dtcs.description: A phase over-current inside cal_asc_oc_window_ms of an LS-ASC entry: the short-circuit transient of the winding's back-EMF (round 23).
dtcs.response: Information, no section-6 row (the low sides hold the ASC; FAULT1 opens only the high sides, which the ASC holds off). Once the window is over and the current back inside the compare, the compare is re-armed and the DTC passes; an over-current outside the window, or one that outlasts it, is DTC_OVERCURRENT.
dtcs.header_comment: round 23 (item 5): a phase over-current inside cal_asc_oc_window_ms of an LS-ASC entry — the short-circuit transient, information (not the control-lost fault); passed once it is over

dtcs.name: DTC_ADC_SLOW_STALE
dtcs.description: A slow-list ADC input (the 1 kHz list: the seven temperatures, V5GD, VOFS, KL15, INTRLOK_N, VSUP on SBC_AMUX) delivered no new conversion for cal_temp_hold_ms, or never converted (round 24, F240): hal_adc_read returns the last conversion and its stamp until the next one.
dtcs.response: Its reading is withdrawn until a new conversion: a temperature channel invalid (its DTC_TEMP_* group; FW-04's invalid-reading derating while no module NTC is valid); V5GD or VOFS leave V_DC invalid (the latched section-6 V_DC-invalid row, named by this DTC; HV unknown; not the V5GD-loss row); KL15 reads absent (the power-down after its debounce); INTRLOK_N reads 0 V (the HVIL signature lost: DTC_HVIL_SHORT, the command-lost ramp); VSUP reads as no reading (DTC_LV_VSUP_UNKNOWN). Passed once every slow input converts again.
dtcs.header_comment: round 24 (F240): Slow-list ADC input (temperature, V5GD, VOFS, KL15, HVIL or LV supply) not converted within the hold time - its reading withdrawn (FW-13, FW-07, FW-09, FW-33)

dtcs.name: DTC_TEMP_OPEN_SHORT
dtcs.description: A temperature channel's last new conversion reads open (at or above cal_ntc_open_v) or short (at or below cal_ntc_short_v) - also a channel whose latched rate fault keeps it invalid and reporting 'rate' (F243): the open or short no longer replaces the latch, so it is recorded here. Set while any of the seven channels reads so, passed when none does.
dtcs.response: Recorded; the channel is invalid (its DTC_TEMP_* group; FW-04's invalid-reading derating while no module NTC is valid) and a latched rate fault stays latched for the key cycle.
dtcs.header_comment: round 24 (F243): Temperature sensor reads open or short - recorded also while its channel's latched rate fault keeps the reading invalid (FW-13)
